title: Space bound for the mapped computation
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $x$ and $y$ be Boolean words, and let $t,D,S$ be natural numbers. Suppose that at every time $u\le t$, the positions of each of the simulator’s first two work-tape heads lie in $[-D,D]$. Suppose also that, for every work tape of $M$, the cells visited by the corresponding simulator tape through time $t$ are among the cells visited by that tape of $M$ when initialized on $y$. If the computation of $M$ initialized on $y$ uses at most $S$ cells through time $t$, then the simulator initialized on $x$ uses at most $S+2(2D+1)$ cells through time $t$.
